canonical_claim: The GCS conditional-write path must never allow `CompleteMultipartUpload`; `WriteBufferFromS3` throws `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` before starting multipart when `s3_force_single_part_upload` is set.
The generation-binding implementation leaves the 412 `PreconditionFailed` detection code untouched because GCS and AWS expose the same body code.

GCS XML API with GOOG4-HMAC-SHA256 signing enforces the required conditional operations, using `x-goog-if-generation-match` and returning `x-goog-generation` as the token.; The GOOG4-HMAC-SHA256 signer was implemented as a sigv4 variant (renamed constants: `GOOG4` key prefix, `goog4_request` scope, `x-goog-date`/`x-goog-content-sha256` headers) plus a precondition-header mapping (`If-None-Match: *` -> `x-goog-if-generation-match: 0`; `If-Match: <etag>` -> `x-goog-if-generation-match: <generation>`) and token extraction from the `x-goog-generation` response header, letting the existing CAS S3 backend target GCS natively via a `http_client = gcs_hmac` opt-in and a `TokenType::Generation` token kind.
Writers consult `store->retireView().isCondemnedToken(hash, token)`; recording the current resurrected token B as condemned makes a later dedup hit re-upload instead of adopting B.
For blob storage objects, the stored object length is the payload length, while `getBlobViewPlan` applies the blob header offset and file window for byte reads.
Blob payload bytes are not cached; a committed view naming a missing blob still surfaces an exception when the payload is read.

The validated CAS safety core is one key per hash plus an in-body incarnation_tag and exact-token body deletion; the freshness-meta work left that core unchanged.; Blob identity uses an in-body incarnation tag and an exact backend token for deletion; generations are absent from object keys, so the `404 → LIST` degraded read path is unnecessary and Keeper is optional.
BlobSource retains a size and a closure that rereads a pending-blob temporary file; it does not retain the payload in memory, and the temporary file remains until commit cleanup after promote.
The tokened promote revalidation uses a bounded loop of up to eight attempts, re-HEADing after each source upload and failing with ABORTED if the leaf remains absent or condemned.
uploadFromSource re-uploads the writer's bytes through head, putIfAbsentStream, and putOverwrite without backend().get, preserving INV-1.
A source-backed condemned or absent blob is re-uploaded and rechecked in a bounded loop; a tokened dependency without a retained source remains an ABORTED fail-closed backstop.
The tokenless copy-forward GET remains the sole documented exception to the never-read-the-dying-object rule; tokened resurrection uses uploadFromSource instead.
The in-closure condemned branch chooses uploadFromSource for a tokened source, copyForwardFromCondemned for a copy-forwardable tokenless dependency, and ABORTED otherwise.
copyForwardFromCondemned verifies the condemned payload hash against the content key and republishes a fresh incarnation using token-conditional putOverwrite.
GC deletes blob bodies with DELETE If-Match against the condemn-time body token; resurrecting with a fresh in-body tag changes the etag so the old exact-token delete misses.
The per-hash .meta object is a two-state clean/condemned freshness marker with condemn_round and size; it is not the delete linearizer and is not read by the data path.

Fresh upload writes the body before a clean meta; dedup adoption point-reads the meta and adopts clean or absent metadata, while condemned metadata triggers resurrection. The writer point-reads metadata for condemned status, writes clean metadata after fresh body upload or resurrection, and may best-effort create clean metadata when adopting a present body with absent metadata.; Upload by placement: new content is written PUT If-None-Match:* (idempotent, dedup hit skips upload); cold reuse of an existing blob point-reads the object's per-hash .meta freshness state (Core/CasBlobMeta.h, MetaState{Clean,Condemned}) — condemned triggers resurrect with a fresh incarnation_tag, else the blob is reused as-is; this point-read replaced the old writer-side retire view.

Tokenless copy-forward reads a still-present condemned body only for an adoptEvidence dependency with an independent committed source owner, verifies the payload hash, and republishes a fresh incarnation.; For tokenless evidence dependencies, `observeAndAdmit` reads and verifies the condemned object, wraps the payload with a fresh `incarnation_tag` and this build's `build_id`, and conditionally overwrites the observed token before admitting the new token.
A condemned non-tokened leaf is copy-forwarded only when isCopyForwardableTokenless is true; otherwise promote throws ABORTED.
The final BlobMeta shape is version, state in {clean, condemned}, condemn_round, and size; Tombstone and the incarnation nonce are excluded because metadata is not the delete linearizer.

Meta codec decoding fails closed on bad magic, version, length, or an invalid state value. The meta codec uses magic `CAMT`, version 2, state, `condemn_round`, size, and a 16-byte `incarnation` field; decoding rejects bad magic, unsupported version, invalid state, wrong length, and the old pre-incarnation length with `CORRUPTED_DATA`.

The shared meta-ops API consists of `loadMeta`, `putMetaIfAbsent`, `casMeta`, and `deleteMetaExact`; `loadMeta` returns an optional `LoadedMeta` containing the decoded `BlobMeta` and etag, and an absent meta returns `nullopt`.
`WriterId` renders as two fixed-width 16-digit lower-case hexadecimal components, for example `0000000000000007-000000000000008e`; upper-case, shortened, zero, and overflowing forms are rejected.
Body-bearing ref-log records use `_log/<incarnation>/<seq>/tx/<body_hash>.proto`, where `body_hash` is the lower-case 32-digit hexadecimal `CityHash128` of the deterministic stored bytes.
The source-edge run format defines `kEdgeActive = 0x01`, `kZeroMarker = 0x00`, `kCondemned = 0x02`, and `kSourceEdgeKeySchema = 1`; old source-edge runs with `key_schema = 0` fail closed.
A `CondemnedRow` stores `delete_pending`, the full `Token`, `size`, and `condemn_round`; `encodeCondemnedRow` uses `[0x02][flags][token_type][round][size][len][value]`.
`openSourceEdgeRun` validates `RunKind::SourceEdge` and `key_schema == kSourceEdgeKeySchema`, and `assertValidSourceEdgeId` reserves `UInt128{0}` for the condemned sentinel namespace.

`CondemnedSummary` contains `condemned_total`, `pending_total`, and `oldest_nonpending_condemn_round`, with `UINT64_MAX` meaning no nonpending condemned row; the protobuf field is `repeated CondemnedSummaryProto condemned_summary = 7`.

`kCondemned` persists the full token type: `ETag = 1`, `Generation = 2`, and `Emulated = 3`; decoding fails with `CORRUPTED_DATA` for an unknown `token_type` or a payload length inconsistent with `token_len`.
`source_id = 0` is reserved for sentinel rows: `sourceEdgeId` must throw `LOGICAL_ERROR` on a zero result and delta producers must reject `source_id == 0`.
